text:
sarah_j: FYI Quantum Health CIO requested an exec-level packet. POC blocked on 3 items: Okta SSO detail, egress encryption/KMS proof, and a hard month-1 spend cap. Need rapid internal escalation.
mike_s: Agree. They want a written commitment for a dedicated POC pool + a one-month price cap. Finance is open to a credit, but legal needs SQ answers before we lock anything.
ajay_k: I can own the Okta config. Can someone share their IdP metadata? last time they had nonstandard claim names. @olivia_p do we have the latest SSO template I can reuse?
olivia_p: Dropping the SSO runbook in a sec (callback URL, ACS, attribute map). Note: Quantum uses email as the unique ID, not sub.
emily_p: For encryption: operations require TLS1.3 and either customer-managed KMS or documented tenant-key workflow. They asked for a short RFC-style writeup for their infra team.
kevin_r: ops-bot: network/kms checklist attached. ```\n- TLS 1.3 enforced\n- Customer-managed KMS supported (AES-256)\n- POC egress restricted to us-east-1 endpoints\n``` 
mike_s: On pricing: can we offer a $X hard cap for month 1 without changing list pricing? Who signs off for a one-off committed credit?
sarah_j: @kevin_r do we have a precedent? I'd rather route through RevOps + exec signoff than change contract terms.
kevin_r: Finance prefers issuing a time-limited credit versus altering list price. That keeps billing clean. We need a RevOps ticket; exec sign-off speeds it up.
ajay_k: I'll draft a tech appendix covering SSO steps, network controls, and instructions for spinning a temporary dedicated pool. ETA 15:00 PT.
olivia_p: Legal-bot: they sent a security questionnaire; key asks: data residency, log retention, and who controls encryption-at-rest keys.
legal-bot: Starting draft responses. Assigning @emily_p for KMS language and @kevin_r for log retention wording.
emily_p: Confirm we support customer-managed KMS for Private. For hosted POC we can provide tenant-isolated keys and a compliance evidence doc.
kevin_r: Logs: default retention 30 days, extendable to 90 days for enterprise; >90 days requires formal request and review.
mike_s: Plan: 1) Ajay finishes appendix by 15:00 PT. 2) Emily & Kevin finalize KMS/log answers by EOD. 3) I open RevOps ticket for pricing credit and request exec review. 4) Sarah sends packet to customer after exec sync.
sarah_j: Please compile a single PDF packet (SSO appendix, network spec, SQ answers). I will present that in the exec call.
ajay_k: PDF draft path: https://redwood.example/sales/qhc-poc-packet (internal). I'll upload the final after edits.
legal-bot: Reminder: any SLA or uptime commitments beyond standard must go through legal + SRE. Do not promise 99.99% for a POC.
sre-oncall: SRE FYI: temporary pool requests must pass the quick review. ops-bot created ticket #SRE-4521.
ops-bot: SRE ticket #SRE-4521 created for temporary pool review.
legal-bot: Legal ticket #LEGAL-789 created for contract language review.
mike_s: I'll escalate pricing to RevOps now and loop back with status here.
sarah_j: Exec sync scheduled 16:30 PT. I'll post the outcome and next steps after the call. Keep replies short in this thread; ping me directly for urgent items. :eyes:
